title: PCB Defects Detection
description: Detect PCB manufacturing defects in an image.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model to identify PCB manufacturing defects—short, spur, missing hole, mouse bite, and open circuit—from AOI inspection imagery. The starter dataset combines research-grade PCB defect benchmarks with in-domain defect-free negatives for robust automated visual inspection before assembly or shipment.
